filters.label: Exchange
filters.title: Exchange
filters.description: Stock Exchange where a stock is listed.

filters.label: Index
filters.title: Index
filters.description: Major market Index that includes the stock.

filters.label: Sector
filters.title: Sector
filters.description: Sector in which a company operates.

filters.label: Industry
filters.title: Industry
filters.description: Industry in which a company operates.

filters.label: Country
filters.title: Country
filters.description: Country where the company is headquartered.

filters.label: Market Cap.
filters.title: Market Capitalization
filters.description: Total market value of a company's outstanding shares (share price x shares outstanding).

filters.label: Dividend Yield
filters.title: Dividend Yield (Fiscal Year Estimate)
filters.description: Annual dividend income as a percentage of the current stock price. If there is no forward dividend estimate available, trailing twelve month (TTM) value is used.

filters.label: Short Float
filters.title: Short Selling
filters.description: Percentage of publicly traded shares sold short.

filters.label: Analyst Recom.
filters.title: Analyst Recommendation
filters.description: Consensus analyst rating on a stock.

filters.label: Option/Short
filters.title: Optionable/Shortable
filters.description: Stocks with options and/or available to sell short.

filters.label: Earnings Date
filters.title: Earnings Date
filters.description: Date when company is expected to report earnings. Relative options are calculated using trading days.

options.label: Current Trading Day, Before Market Open
Current Trading Day, After Market Close
Next Trading Day, Before Market Open
Next Trading Day, After Market Close
Previous Trading Day, Before Market Open
Previous Trading Day, After Market Close

filters.label: Average Volume
filters.title: Average Volume
filters.description: Average number of shares traded per day.

filters.label: Relative Volume
filters.title: Relative Volume
filters.description: Ratio of current volume compared to 3-month average, adjusted intraday.

filters.label: Current Volume
filters.title: Current Volume
filters.description: Number of shares traded today.

filters.label: Price $
filters.title: Price $
filters.description: The current stock price.

filters.label: Target Price
filters.title: Target Price
filters.description: Average projected price by Analysts.

filters.label: IPO Date
filters.title: IPO Date
filters.description: Date the company first became publicly traded.

filters.label: Shares Outstanding
filters.title: Shares Outstanding
filters.description: Total number of shares issued and currently held by investors.

filters.label: Float
filters.title: Float
filters.description: The number of shares available for public trading. Doesn't include shares held by insiders.

filters.label: Theme
filters.title: Theme
filters.description: Investing themes associated with the company.

filters.label: Sub-theme
filters.title: Sub-theme
filters.description: Investing sub-themes associated with the company.

filters.label: Dilution Risk
filters.title: Dilution Risk
filters.description: Overall risk of new share issuance, based on offering ability, cash need, overhang and dilution history.

filters.label: P/E
filters.title: Price-to-Earnings Ratio
filters.description: Valuation ratio comparing stock price to earnings per share over trailing twelve months (TTM).

filters.label: Forward P/E
filters.title: Forward Price-to-Earnings Ratio
filters.description: P/E Ratio based on estimated future earnings for next fiscal year.

filters.label: PEG
filters.title: Price-to-Earnings-to-Growth
filters.description: Valuation ratio comparing a company's P/E ratio to its earnings growth.

filters.label: P/S
filters.title: Price-to-Sales Ratio
filters.description: Valuation ratio comparing stock price to company's sales.

filters.label: P/B
filters.title: Price-to-Book Ratio
filters.description: Valuation ratio comparing stock price to company's book value per share.

filters.label: Price/Cash
filters.title: Price-to-Cash Ratio
filters.description: Ratio comparing stock price to total cash held by the company. Calculated as Closing Price divided by latest quarter Cash Per Share.

filters.label: Price/Free Cash Flow
filters.title: Price to Free Cash Flow (TTM)
filters.description: Valuation ratio comparing stock price to company's free cash flow (TTM).

filters.label: EV/EBITDA
filters.title: Enterprise Value to EBITDA
filters.description: Valuation ratio comparing company's Enterprise Value to its earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (TTM).

filters.label: EV/Sales
filters.title: Enterprise Value to Sales
filters.description: Valuation ratio comparing company's Enterprise Value to company's sales (TTM).

filters.label: Dividend Growth
filters.title: Dividend Growth
filters.description: Annualized dividend growth over 1, 3, or 5 years or consecutive years of growth.

filters.label: EPS Growth This Year
filters.title: Earnings Per Share, Growth This Year
filters.description: EPS growth this year. Earnings Per Share = Net Income / Number of Shares Outstanding.

filters.label: EPS Growth Next Year
filters.title: Earnings Per Share, Growth Next Year
filters.description: EPS growth estimated next year. Earnings Per Share = Net Income / Number of Shares Outstanding.

filters.label: EPS Growth Qtr Over Qtr
filters.title: Earnings Per Share, Growth Quarter Over Quarter
filters.description: EPS is the portion of a company's profit allocated to each outstanding share of common stock. EPS serves as an indicator of a company's profitability. Quarter over quarter growth.

filters.label: EPS Growth TTM
filters.title: EPS Growth Trailing Twelve Months (TTM)
filters.description: Earnings Per Share growth over past 12 months compared to prior year.

filters.label: EPS Growth Past 3 Years
filters.title: Earnings Per Share, Growth Past 3 Years
filters.description: EPS annual growth over past 3 years. Earnings Per Share = Net Income / Number of Shares Outstanding.

filters.label: EPS Growth Past 5 Years
filters.title: Earnings Per Share, Growth Past 5 Years
filters.description: EPS annual growth over past 5 years. Earnings Per Share = Net Income / Number of Shares Outstanding.

filters.label: EPS Growth Next 5 Years
filters.title: Earnings Per Share, Growth Next 5 Years
filters.description: EPS annual growth estimated next 5 years. Earnings Per Share = Net Income / Number of Shares Outstanding.

filters.label: Sales Growth Qtr Over Qtr
filters.title: Sales Growth Quarter Over Quarter (YoY)
filters.description: Sales growth comparing most recent quarter to same quarter last year.

filters.label: Sales Growth TTM
filters.title: Sales Growth Trailing Twelve Months (TTM)
filters.description: Sales growth over past 12 months compared to prior year.

filters.label: Sales Growth Past 3 Years
filters.title: Sales Growth Past 3 Years
filters.description: Sales annual growth over past 3 years.

filters.label: Sales Growth Past 5 Years
filters.title: Sales Growth Past 5 Years
filters.description: Sales annual growth over past 5 years.

filters.label: Earnings & Revenue Surprise
filters.title: Earnings & Revenue Surprise
filters.description: Company's EPS and/or Revenue compared to analyst estimates.

filters.label: Return on Assets
filters.title: Return on Assets (TTM)
filters.description: Net Income divided by Total Assets. Measures how efficiently a company generates profit from its assets.

filters.label: Return on Equity
filters.title: Return on Equity (TTM)
filters.description: Net Income divided by Shareholders' Equity. Measures how efficiently a company generates profit from equity.

filters.label: Return on Invested Capital
filters.title: Return on Invested Capital (TTM)
filters.description: Net Income divided by Invested Capital. Measures how efficiently a company generates profit from the capital invested in its business.

filters.label: Current Ratio
filters.title: Current Ratio (MRQ)
filters.description: Current Assets divided by Current Liabilities. A liquidity measure showing the company's ability to meet short-term obligations.

filters.label: Quick Ratio
filters.title: Quick Ratio (MRQ)
filters.description: (Current Assets - Inventory - Prepaids) divided by Current Liabilities. Liquidity measure showing company's ability to meet short-term obligations with its most liquid assets.

filters.label: LT Debt/Equity
filters.title: Long Term Debt to Equity (MRQ)
filters.description: Ratio of Long Term Debt to Shareholders' Equity. Measures company's financial leverage.

filters.label: Debt/Equity
filters.title: Total Debt to Equity (MRQ)
filters.description: Ratio of Total Debt to Shareholders' Equity. Measures company's financial leverage.

filters.label: Gross Margin
filters.title: Gross Margin (TTM)
filters.description: Percentage of revenue remaining as gross profit after deducting the cost of goods sold. Measures profit above what it costs the company to produce its goods or services.

filters.label: Operating Margin
filters.title: Operating Margin (TTM)
filters.description: Percentage of revenue remaining as operating income after operating expenses are subtracted. Measures profitability to a company's core business.

filters.label: Net Profit Margin
filters.title: Net Profit Margin (TTM)
filters.description: Percentage of revenue remaining as net income after all expenses, taxes, interest, and costs are deducted. Measures bottom-line profitability.

filters.label: Payout Ratio
filters.title: Payout Ratio
filters.description: Percentage of earnings paid out as dividends.

filters.label: Insider Ownership
filters.title: Insider Ownership
filters.description: Percentage of shares owned by insiders and management.

filters.label: Insider Transactions
filters.title: Insider Transactions
filters.description: Six-month change in insider ownership.

filters.label: Institutional Ownership
filters.title: Institutional Ownership
filters.description: Percentage of shares owned by institutional investors.

filters.label: Institutional Transactions
filters.title: Institutional Transactions
filters.description: Three-month change in institutional ownership.

filters.label: Performance
filters.title: Performance
filters.description: Rate of return for a given stock.

filters.label: Performance 2
filters.title: Performance 2
filters.description: Rate of return for a given stock.

filters.label: Volatility
filters.title: Volatility
filters.description: Statistical measure of how much a security's price fluctuates over time, often expressed as the size or dispersion of its returns.

filters.label: RSI (14)
filters.title: Relative Strength Index (14)
filters.description: Momentum oscillator that measures the speed and magnitude of recent price changes to indicate whether a security is overbought or oversold.

filters.label: Gap
filters.title: Gap
filters.description: The difference between yesterday's closing price and today's opening price. Before the market opens, the first premarket trade is used as the opening price. After the market opens, it is replaced with the regular session open.

filters.label: 20-Day Simple Moving Average
filters.title: 20-Day Simple Moving Average
filters.description: Average closing price over the previous 20 trading days.

filters.label: 50-Day Simple Moving Average
filters.title: 50-Day Simple Moving Average
filters.description: Average closing price over the previous 50 trading days.

filters.label: 200-Day Simple Moving Average
filters.title: 200-Day Simple Moving Average
filters.description: Average closing price over the previous 200 trading days.

filters.label: Change
filters.title: Change from previous Close
filters.description: Difference between previous Close price and Current price.

filters.label: Change from Open
filters.title: Change from Open
filters.description: Difference between today's Open price and Current price.

filters.label: 20-Day High/Low
filters.title: 20-Day High/Low
filters.description: Highest and lowest price over previous 20 days, and how far current stock price is from those levels.

filters.label: 50-Day High/Low
filters.title: 50-Day High/Low
filters.description: Highest and lowest price over previous 50 days, and how far current stock price is from those levels.

filters.label: 52-Week High/Low
filters.title: 52-Week High/Low
filters.description: Highest and lowest price over previous 52 weeks (1 year), and how far current stock price is from those levels.

filters.label: All-Time High/Low
filters.title: All-Time High/Low
filters.description: Highest and lowest price in stock's history, and how far current stock price is from those levels.

filters.label: Pattern
filters.title: Pattern
filters.description: Chart patterns that may signal a reversal or continuation of trend.

filters.label: Candlestick
filters.title: Candlestick
filters.description: Candlestick pattern on the daily candle (bar). Candlestick is a visual representation of Open, High, Low, Close.

filters.label: Beta
filters.title: Beta
filters.description: A measure of a stock's price volatility compared to the overall market. S&P 500 has a Beta of 1. Positive Beta = stock is correlated with the market. Negative Beta = stock is negatively correlated.

filters.label: Average True Range
filters.title: Average True Range
filters.description: A measure of stock volatility. The Average True Range is an exponential moving average (14-days) of the True Ranges. The range of a day's trading is high-low, True Range extends it to yesterday's closing price if it was outside of today's range, True Range = max(high, closeprev) - min(low, closeprev).

filters.label: Latest News
filters.title: Latest News
filters.description: Date of most recent news related to the company.
